description: Gatus: endpoint status, uptime, outages and response times. Collapsed rows hold ongoing outages, failures per hour, response time, status codes, certificate and domain expiry, and runtime cost.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether every endpoint's latest check passed: DEGRADED when some fail, DOWN when all do, OFFLINE when Gatus is unreachable.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Average endpoint uptime in the selected range: each endpoint's share of passing checks.
